source_context.hr: Prije komentara prikazati izdavača, originalni link, datum i atribuciju te jasno odvojiti provjerljivu činjenicu od uredničkog komentara.
source_context.en: Before commentary, show publisher, original link, date and attribution, and clearly separate verifiable fact from editorial commentary.

weekly.note_hr: Brojke opisuju lokalni 30-dnevni urednički plan GNK ASG-a; ne dokazuju vanjsku objavu ili aktivnost trećih strana.
weekly.note_en: Figures describe GNK ASG's local 30-day editorial plan; they do not prove external publication or third-party activity.

assumptions_hr: Organizacije uvode kontrolirane AI pomoćnike uz ljudski approval gate.
assumptions_en: Organisations introduce controlled AI assistants with a human approval gate.
evidence_basis_hr: Potrebni su provjerljivi podaci o usvajanju, regulativi i stvarnim workflowima.
evidence_basis_en: Requires verifiable adoption, regulatory and real-workflow evidence.
risks_hr: Pogrešna automatizacija, nejasna odgovornost, loša kvaliteta podataka.
risks_en: Faulty automation, unclear accountability and poor data quality.
falsification_hr: Scenarij slabi ako regulativa ili operativni dokazi pokažu da se takva uporaba ne širi.
falsification_en: The scenario weakens if regulation or operational evidence shows that such use is not expanding.
